items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Only one, that was Scottie's band thing, (unintelligible) "Swingmatism."

ctx.x: But, Gene, one thing, since we're talking about McShann's records, as a result of these -- the popularity of these blues records, you never got to record all the bands' arrangements, did you?
Only one, that was Scottie's band thing, (unintelligible) "Swingmatism."
Yeah. Well, Jay told me that when he was inducted off the bandstand, that night the book was stolen.
